notes.title: Weefager: Demo Now Available! Embark on Your Etheric Adventure Today!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=P-Y2WFGgUIE;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

The wait is over! We’re thrilled to announce that the Weefager demo is now available on Steam. This is your first step into an unforgettable journey through a world filled with mystery and magic.

Weefager is a [b]2D metroidvania[/b] game, entirely [b]developed by only one person[/b]. Every aspect of the game has been meticulously handcrafted, from the beautifully detailed animations to the immersive soundtrack that accompanies you throughout your adventure. This project is a true labor of love, with every detail carefully designed to deliver a distinctive and engaging experience.

In the demo, you'll be introduced to the story and get to explore part of the first area: the Forest of Time. As you venture deeper into this magical environment, you'll encounter [b]enemies whose souls you can extract[/b] and even face the first boss: Wormy, a fig doused with ether that gave him life and plagues the forest with worms.

Don't miss your chance to experience the beginning of Weefager’s epic adventure. [b]Download the demo[/b] now on Steam and get a glimpse of the magic you'll experience when the full game is released!

Link to the demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3146460/Weefager_Demo/
